eligibility.comparisonBasis: Both C0 cuts satisfied the source contract and were eligible for synthesis.

fromCodex: Operational-enterprise narrative spine from exception to governed change
C03 hero orchestration with one light accountability record
WorkGraph provenance and Factory stop-before-release proof
Two governed surfaces with an explicit truth boundary
fromClaude: More direct articulation of operational consequence

tradeoff.codexOptimizes: Calm authority, legible executive hierarchy and one continuous operating-model argument.
tradeoff.codexGivesUp: Some of Claude's immediate state-change drama and explicit exception comparison.
tradeoff.claudeOptimizes: Operational tension and a clear interactive contrast between a permitted path and a material exception.
tradeoff.claudeGivesUp: Editorial restraint and a single unambiguous hierarchy when signal bands and records accumulate.
tradeoff.directorDecision: Keep the Codex composition and narrative spine; transfer only Claude's bounded exception toggle and strongest assessment line.

selectedSpine.narrative: Stakes, strategic decision, retained company context, governed build, two surfaces, controlled operation, impact and assessment.
selectedSpine.composition: Codex C0 composition with one hero accountability record and no separate signal band.
selectedSpine.copy: Codex restraint with the authorized lighter lead and P1R2 human-approval language.
selectedSpine.image: C03 as a Decision Field supported by restrained Machine Signal; Operational Evidence is expressed in HTML below the hero.
selectedSpine.interaction: One finite permitted-path/material-exception toggle in Operate/Trust, progressively enhanced from a complete static reading order.

rejectedAveraging: No separate signal band from Claude beneath the Codex hero
No second Trust model or parallel operating-state component
No compromise hero composition that weakens C03's single image role
No blending of both cuts' repeated explanatory copy

boundedCopyAmendment.previousLead: Dagg maps the real company, builds the justified agents and software, and keeps context, permissions, owners and evidence attached as work moves into execution.
boundedCopyAmendment.replacementLead: Dagg carries strategic judgment into governed execution, so the company can change how work runs without losing context or control.
boundedCopyAmendment.reason: The prior lead read as a capability inventory; the authorized C1 sentence carries the same scope with less weight.
boundedCopyAmendment.scope: C1 only; neither C0 source was edited.
boundedCopyAmendment.releaseLanguage: Every occurrence of human release uses the exact P1R2 human approval for release phrase; named accountable approvals remain explicit.
boundedCopyAmendment.mismatchLogic: A mismatch is found; the draft is withheld. The mismatch itself is never described as withheld.

imageRole.operationalEvidence: Coded, selectable and legible HTML rather than bitmap evidence.

limitations: The C03 rail or tunnel ambiguity must still be judged inside the assembled desktop and mobile carriers.
No assembler was run by the C1 builder.
Desktop, mobile, touch, keyboard, reduced-motion, no-JS and console audits remain pending for root.
Constructed states are product explanations, not client data, production deployments or claimed outcomes.
